value: **Embodied & Participatory Modeling**: Leverages embodied, mixed-reality, or physical role-play activities to ground learners' sense-making and computational modeling of complex systems. Evidence: "We focus on two days of an eight-day mixed reality (MR) enhanced, embodied modeling curriculum where students play the roles of bees and flowers."
